meta.name: healthcheck
meta.description: Use when auditing or hardening the host running CrawClaw, including security posture review, exposure assessment, firewall or SSH hardening, periodic host audits, or version checks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计并加固运行主机的安全配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要定期对服务器进行安全状况评估和加固。
copy.tagline_en: Audit and harden security posture of your host
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need regular security assessment and hardening for your servers.

howto.what: Claude 会评估运行 CrawClaw 的主机，然后根据你的风险偏好提出加固计划，包括安全审计、更新检查和修复步骤，并在你批准后执行。
howto.when: 当你要求审计或加固运行 CrawClaw 的主机，例如检查安全态势、防火墙、SSH 配置或版本时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一次 CrawClaw 主机的安全审计。
say.note: Claude 会请求许可并运行审计。

say.text: 检查当前防火墙和 SSH 配置。
say.note: Claude 会收集上下文并提出改进建议。

say.text: 生成加固计划，风险偏好选“开发者便捷”。
say.note: Claude 会生成对应的修复步骤。

howto.what_en: Claude will assess the host running CrawClaw and propose a hardening plan matching your risk tolerance, including security audit, update check, and remediation steps, executing only after your approval.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to audit or harden the CrawClaw host, such as checking security posture, firewall, SSH configuration, or versions.

say_en.text: Run a security audit on the CrawClaw host.
say_en.note: Claude will ask permission and run the audit.

say_en.text: Check current firewall and SSH config.
say_en.note: Claude will gather context and suggest improvements.

say_en.text: Generate a hardening plan with risk posture 'developer convenience'.
say_en.note: Claude will produce corresponding remediation steps.
